When traveling for business, what you'd most want to equip your Apple devices with isn't a bunch of cables and outlet adapters, but something that can handle everything in one go. There are indeed plenty of options on the market, but they're usually quite bulky. Anker's Prime Qi2 25W Foldable 3-in-1 Wireless Charger is designed to solve this problem. It can fold flat, weighs about the same as an iPhone 17 Pro Max, and can charge your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods simultaneously.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers breaks down the latest news from the MagSafe and wireless charging industry to help you get the most out of your wireless charging-compatible Apple devices.

A Foldable 3-in-1 Charger

As its name suggests, the selling point of this product is that it's only palm-sized and can fold flat to slip into a trouser pocket, backpack, or sling bag, taking up virtually no room. I've tried bringing quite a few MagSafe stands on trips, and almost every time they're the bulkiest item in my laptop bag.

Qi2 25W Charging Speed

It's Qi2.2 certified, with MagSafe charging power reaching up to 25W—much faster than the 7.5W ceiling that most MagSafe accessories have been stuck at for years. Anker claims it can charge an iPhone 17 Pro to 50% in 26 minutes, up to 5 times faster than a standard 5W wireless charger. Actual performance will vary depending on your iPhone model and temperature, but even coming close to that level is already quite impressive.

Faster MagSafe charging speeds usually mean more heat, so Anker has added what they call AirCool temperature control. Operating at just 19 decibels, it's so quiet you won't even notice it working. The design keeps your phone temperature below 98.6°F while maintaining full 25W output. Heat is the enemy of both battery longevity and charging speed, so if this feature actually delivers on its claims in daily use, it's far more than just marketing fluff—it's a genuine selling point.

This 3-in-1 design covers all your needs: the main MagSafe disc charges your iPhone, the side features an MFi-certified Apple Watch charger, and the charging pad at the bottom handles your AirPods. The core value of this type of charging dock is simple: just one cord to the wall outlet, instead of three separate chargers and three separate cables crammed together. The accessories included in the box are:

  • Anker Prime Wireless Charging Dock
  • 45W USB-C Wall Charger
  • 5-foot USB-C to USB-C Cable

I really appreciate that Anker includes a wall charger in the box, because many similar products assume you already have a fast enough charger. It also supports 110V to 220V input, so you won't need to bring an extra voltage converter when traveling abroad.

Conclusion

Anker has released quite a few 3-in-1 chargers over the years, but the foldable design is what sets this one apart in a competitive market. It truly addresses the main reason most people don't bring a charging dock when traveling: traditional designs simply don't fit well in luggage. This one solves that problem.

You can purchase the Anker Prime Qi2 25W Foldable 3-in-1 Wireless Charger directly from Amazon or Anker's official website.
